value.rationale: Exact distributions of standard intrinsic endomorphism-monoid classes (idempotents, regular elements) at every image dimension for arbitrary cycle profiles and finite fields. This extends known global Hom counts and qualitative regularity criteria to complete fiber frequencies and reveals arithmetic jumps depending on roots of unity, as illustrated by (1,2) over q=2 versus q=4. These are natural, parameter-unbounded exact invariants, not artificially sliced examples.
